task_routing.task_class: read-only inspection, documentation-only edits, deterministic local tests, reversible evidence indexing
task_routing.boundary: Repository-only, reversible, with diff and test verification

task_routing.task_class: mechanically understood packaging, bounded local benchmarking, nonce-bound worker dispatch
task_routing.boundary: Stop for human.approve_commit before external effect or promotion

task_routing.task_class: product wording, open design tradeoffs, user-facing interpretation
training, candidate selection, parity, release evaluation, architecture changes
task_routing.boundary: Human decision with AI evidence, alternatives, and dissent

task_routing.task_class: production enablement, deployment, publication, credential approval, unverified safety or privacy judgment
task_routing.boundary: Human performs or explicitly takes over

bounds.scope: Develop and verify one smallest-sufficient sub-5B Wrench SLM and its bounded model-local runtime, real client integrations, worker evaluation, and release evidence.
permissions: read the repository and approved redacted evaluation inputs
make reversible changes inside the repository
run approved local tests and bounded evaluation entry points
dispatch nonce-bound worker jobs through the approved queue
prohibited_actions: publish or release an artifact without human approval
spend provider money without an approved child contract
upload customer data or unrestricted private data
weaken verifier, safety, or evidence gates
claim parity or production value from a smoke, HTTP 200, or offline result
data_access: worker receipts that contain no credentials or unrestricted private data

evidence_required: hash-bound source, artifact, tokenizer, runtime, and verifier identities
resource snapshots preserving 10 percent RAM and VRAM reserve
worker nonce, job ID, host identity, command marker, and response schema
failure logs and preserved rejected or unverified evidence
paired token, cost, latency, retry, correction, and outcome accounting
human decision receipt before promotion, publication, deployment, or spend

rollback.procedure: Disable learned routing, restore the named source and artifact recovery point, preserve all receipts and failures, and do not rewrite evidence.
rollback.recovery_point: Record source commit, artifact manifest hash, tokenizer hash, runtime identity, verifier identity, and working-tree state before each consequential task.
